content:
name: npm Publish

on:
    push:
        branches: [main]
    release:
        types: [published]

permissions:
    contents: read

jobs:
    build-dev:
        if: github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
        runs-on: ubuntu-latest
        steps:
            - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
              with:
                  persist-credentials: false
            - name: Use Node.js 24
              uses: actions/setup-node@v6
              with:
                  node-version: 24.18.1
                  package-manager-cache: false
            - run: corepack enable
            - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
            # All three dev packages build here; pnpm's topological order builds the library before the plugins, whose test:exports gates verify their packed tarballs against the library's built shape. The plugin core and the configurator are inlined into the plugin bundles and have no dev release of their own. A new package joins these jobs only after its npm trusted publisher exists (see agents/release-workflow.md).
            - run: pnpm --filter tailwind-merge --filter @tailwind-merge/vite --filter @tailwind-merge/next build
            - run: pnpm --filter tailwind-merge --filter @tailwind-merge/vite --filter @tailwind-merge/next test:exports
            - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
              with:
                  name: build-output-tailwind-merge
                  path: packages/tailwind-merge/dist
                  if-no-files-found: error
            - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
              with:
                  name: build-output-vite
                  path: packages/vite/dist
                  if-no-files-found: error
            - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
              with:
                  name: build-output-next
                  path: packages/next/dist
                  if-no-files-found: error

    publish-dev:
        if: github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
        needs: build-dev
        runs-on: ubuntu-latest
        permissions:
            contents: read
            # Necessary for OIDC permissions for trusted publishing. Keep this isolated from dependency installation and build scripts.
            id-token: write
        steps:
            - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
              with:
                  persist-credentials: false
            - name: Use Node.js 24
              uses: actions/setup-node@v6
              with:
                  node-version: 24.18.1
                  # No registry-url on purpose: it would write an .npmrc auth line referencing the unset NODE_AUTH_TOKEN, which pnpm's config loader rejects. pnpm publishes to its default registry through npm trusted publishing (OIDC), needing no token plumbing.
                  package-manager-cache: false
            - run: corepack enable
            # The plugins' devDependencies keep `workspace:` specifiers (the inlined plugin core and configurator), which pnpm rewrites at publish time by reading the linked manifests from node_modules — the same scripts-disabled, package-filtered install the release job uses, so no dependency code runs in the job holding the OIDC token. tailwind-merge needs no install: its specifiers are all `catalog:` and resolve from pnpm-workspace.yaml.
            - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts --filter @tailwind-merge/vite --filter @tailwind-merge/next
            - uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c # v8.0.1
              with:
                  name: build-output-tailwind-merge
                  path: packages/tailwind-merge/dist
                  digest-mismatch: error
            - uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c # v8.0.1
              with:
                  name: build-output-vite
                  path: packages/vite/dist
                  digest-mismatch: error
            - uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c # v8.0.1
              with:
                  name: build-output-next
                  path: packages/next/dist
                  digest-mismatch: error
            # Stamps `<version>-dev.<sha>` on all three manifests and pins the plugins' tailwind-merge dependency to the library's same-commit dev version (see the script header for why the pin is exact). All stamps run before any publish so the manifests agree before anything leaves the runner.
            - name: Stamp dev versions
              run: |
                  (cd packages/tailwind-merge && node ../../scripts/stamp-dev-version.mjs)
                  (cd packages/vite && node ../../scripts/stamp-dev-version.mjs)
                  (cd packages/next && node ../../scripts/stamp-dev-version.mjs)
            # pnpm instead of npm so publishing matches the release flow: publishConfig field overrides are applied at pack time and trusted publishing runs through pnpm's native OIDC flow. --provenance must be explicit (pnpm does not read publishConfig.provenance); --no-git-checks because the version stamp above dirties the tree and the checkout is a detached HEAD. The library publishes first because the plugins' dev builds depend on exactly this version.
            - run: pnpm publish --access public --tag dev --provenance --ignore-scripts --no-git-checks
              working-directory: packages/tailwind-merge
            - run: pnpm publish --access public --tag dev --provenance --ignore-scripts --no-git-checks
              working-directory: packages/vite
            - run: pnpm publish --access public --tag dev --provenance --ignore-scripts --no-git-checks
              working-directory: packages/next

    build-prod:
        if: github.event_name == 'release' && github.event.action == 'published'
        runs-on: ubuntu-latest
        outputs:
            package-name: ${{ steps.resolve_package.outputs.name }}
            package-dir: ${{ steps.resolve_package.outputs.dir }}
        steps:
            - name: Resolve the released package from the release tag
              id: resolve_package
              env:
                  RELEASE_TAG: ${{ github.event.release.tag_name }}
              run: |
                  # Release tags are namespaced per package (<package-name>@<version>); plain v-prefixed tags predate the monorepo and belong to tailwind-merge.
                  case "$RELEASE_TAG" in
                      tailwind-merge@*|v*)
                          name=tailwind-merge
                          dir=packages/tailwind-merge
                          ;;
                      @tailwind-merge/vite@*)
                          name=@tailwind-merge/vite
                          dir=packages/vite
                          ;;
                      @tailwind-merge/next@*)
                          name=@tailwind-merge/next
                          dir=packages/next
                          ;;
                      *)
                          echo "::error::Cannot resolve a workspace package from release tag ${RELEASE_TAG}"
                          exit 1
                          ;;
                  esac
                  echo "name=${name}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
                  echo "dir=${dir}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
              with:
                  persist-credentials: false
            - name: Use Node.js 24
              uses: actions/setup-node@v6
              with:
                  node-version: 24.18.1
                  package-manager-cache: false
            - run: corepack enable
            - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
            - run: pnpm lint
            - run: pnpm test
            # The library builds in every release flow: the plugins' test:exports gates verify their packed tarballs against tailwind-merge's published shape (dist and types). For a tailwind-merge release the two filters name the same package and it builds once; for a plugin release pnpm's topological order builds the library first.
            - run: pnpm --filter tailwind-merge --filter "$PACKAGE_NAME" build
              env:
                  PACKAGE_NAME: ${{ steps.resolve_package.outputs.name }}
            # Every package ships a test:exports release gate: the library's built-bundle smoke tests, the plugins' packed-tarball verification.
            - run: pnpm --filter "$PACKAGE_NAME" test:exports
              env:
                  PACKAGE_NAME: ${{ steps.resolve_package.outputs.name }}
            # A plugin release resolves its tailwind-merge dependency on the registry, unlike the packed gate, which links the workspace build. This checks that the range's lowest version is published and ships every unstable-entry-point import the bundled plugin core and configurator make, so a plugin cannot ship against a library release that lacks the internals it was built with.
            - if: startsWith(steps.resolve_package.outputs.name, '@tailwind-merge/')
              run: pnpm --filter "$PACKAGE_NAME" test:library-release
              env:
                  PACKAGE_NAME: ${{ steps.resolve_package.outputs.name }}
            - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
              with:
                  name: build-output
                  path: ${{ steps.resolve_package.outputs.dir }}/dist
                  if-no-files-found: error

    publish-prod:
        if: github.event_name == 'release' && github.event.action == 'published'
        needs: build-prod
        runs-on: ubuntu-latest
        permissions:
            contents: read
            # Necessary for OIDC permissions for trusted publishing. Keep this isolated from dependency installation and build scripts.
            id-token: write
        steps:
            - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
              with:
                  persist-credentials: false
            - name: Use Node.js 24
              uses: actions/setup-node@v6
              with:
                  node-version: 24.18.1
                  # No registry-url on purpose: it would write an .npmrc auth line referencing the unset NODE_AUTH_TOKEN, which pnpm's config loader rejects. pnpm publishes to its default registry through npm trusted publishing (OIDC), needing no token plumbing.
                  package-manager-cache: false
            - run: corepack enable
            # pnpm resolves `workspace:` specifiers at publish time by reading the linked package's manifest from node_modules (the plugins depend on tailwind-merge that way), so the released package's dependencies are installed here — for that package only, with lifecycle scripts disabled, so no dependency code runs in the job holding the OIDC token. `catalog:` specifiers need no install; they resolve from pnpm-workspace.yaml.
            - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts --filter "$PACKAGE_NAME"
              env:
                  PACKAGE_NAME: ${{ needs.build-prod.outputs.package-name }}
            - uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c # v8.0.1
              with:
                  name: build-output
                  path: ${{ needs.build-prod.outputs.package-dir }}/dist
                  digest-mismatch: error
            # pnpm instead of npm: pnpm applies publishConfig field overrides at pack time (the vite package swaps its dist exports in that way) and implements npm trusted publishing natively (GitHub OIDC id-token, exchanged per package at the registry, publishing through npm's own libnpmpublish vendored inside pnpm). --provenance must be explicit because pnpm does not read publishConfig.provenance; --no-git-checks because the checkout is a detached HEAD. --access public covers the first publish of scoped packages (@tailwind-merge/*); it is the default for the unscoped tailwind-merge anyway.
            - run: pnpm publish --access public --provenance --ignore-scripts --no-git-checks
              working-directory: ${{ needs.build-prod.outputs.package-dir }}
